contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-337),Trier mint Constantinopolis commemorative issue of 332-333, Reece period 17; RIC vol. 7 page 217 no. 548. Obverse description: Constantinopolis helmeted, mantled ?and cuirassed left with sceptre over left shoulder. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN TINOPOLIS. Reverse description: Victory advancing left on prow with shield and spear. In exergue: TR.P'. Diameter: 17.4mm, Weight: 1.98gms, die axis: 6
